actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The druid makes two attacks, using Vine Staff or Verdant Wisp in any combination.

actions.name: Vine Staff
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +5, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

actions.name: Verdant Wisp
actions.text: _Ranged Attack Roll:_ +5, range 90 ft. _Hit:_ 10 (3d6) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text:
The druid casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):
 **At Will:** _Druidcraft, Speak with Animals_
 **2/Day Each:** _Entangle, Thunderwave_
 **1/Day Each:** _Animal Messenger, Long-strider, Moonbeam_ ## Dryad
